question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"perished."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Perished" **means to die, to come to an end. or be destroyed. (मर जाना या नष्‍ट हो जाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The flowers in the garden **perished**__ after the frost.*
 
 
 
• The word is often used to describe the death of living things, but can also refer to the end of non-living things.
 
• Grammatically, **"perished"** is the past tense of **"perish."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

The Grim Reaper seems to have __appeared__ in Europe during the 14th century. It was during this time that Europe was dealing with what was then the world’s __worst__ pandemic, the Black Death, believed to be the result of the plague. It is estimated that about one-third of Europe’s entire population __**perished**__ as a result of the pandemic, with some areas of the continent suffering far greater losses than others. The original outbreak of the plague occurred during 1347–51, and outbreaks then ______ (4) ______ several other times after that. So, clearly, death was something that the surviving Europeans had on their mind, and it is not surprising that they ______ (5) ______ an image to represent it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Vanished"** means to disappear suddenly or without a trace. (एकाएक ग़ायब हो जाना (ऐसे कि पता न चले), ओझल हो जाना)
 
• **"Shriveled"** means to become smaller and wrinkled due to loss of moisture. (मुरझा या सूख जाना (विशेषतः गरमी पड़ने के कारण))
 
• **"Moldered"** means to decay or decompose over time. (to decay or decompose over time.)
